blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types. We begin with controlled experiments in which we train small LMs (163M parameters) on mixtures of natural text from pretraining corpora and synthetic task data. Our analysis identifies three distinct phases of learning: (1) an early phase where the LM selects entities by frequency, (2) a middle phase where the LM selects entities by position in the prompt (first vs. last mentioned entity), and (3) a late phase where the LM selects the entity that is the correct answer. We show that the emergence of these three phases is causally determined by statistical properties of the training data. With small amounts of task-specific synthetic data, we observe only the first two phases and the model fails to learn the task; with large amounts, the model jumps directly from the frequency-based heuristic to solving the task correctly. Moreover, changing the entity frequency distribution from a naturally occurring Zipfian distribution (a small number of entities are very common and the vast majority are rare) to a uniform one weakens the frequency phase and speeds up learning of the task. Lastly, we show that the three phases of training dynamics from our controlled experiments appear in the open source model OLMo-2 32B. Together, our findings demonstrate that properties of pretraining data are causal drivers of heuristic learning and show that small-scale synthetic experiments can predict training dynamics at larger scales.
blocks.zh: 在整个预训过程中数据如何塑造语言模型(LM)行为? 我们通过实体比较案例研究来调查这个问题,例如法国和巴西之间的比较,哪个国家比较大? 在涉及五个实体类型的九个比较任务中。 我们首先从控制实验开始,我们从预先训练蝎子和合成任务数据中,对自然文本的混合物进行小型LM(163M参数)训练。 我们的分析确定了三个不同的学习阶段:(1) LM按频率选择实体的早期阶段,(2) LM按即时位置选择实体的中间阶段(第一对最后提到的实体),(3) LM选择正确答案的实体的后期阶段. 我们显示,这三个阶段的出现是由培训数据的统计特性决定的。 以少量的任务特异性合成数据,我们只观察前两个阶段,模型未能学习任务;以大量,模型直接从基于频率的heuristic跳到正确解决任务. 此外,将实体频率分布从自然发生的Zipfian分布(少数实体非常常见,绝大多数为罕见)改为统一分布,削弱了频率阶段,加快了对任务的学习. 最后,我们表明,我们控制下的实验所产生的三个培训动态阶段出现在开放源码模型OLMo-2 32B中。 我们的调查结果表明,预训数据的性质是热力学学习的因果驱动力,并表明小规模的合成实验可以在更大的尺度上预测训练动力学.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
What does a language model (LM) learn throughout pretraining and how do statistical properties of data drive these learning dynamics?
The relationship between data and model has proven fertile ground for interpretability research, with recent works uncovering how properties of data drive the formation of structured internal representations ( Merullo et al., 2025 ; Karkada et al., 2026 ; Prieto et al., 2026 ) , algorithmic motifs ( Olsson et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , generalization capabilities ( Chan et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Ruis et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , and imperfect heuristics ( Elazar et al., 2022 ; He et al., 2025 ; Kalai et al., 2025 ) .
We conduct a case study on learning dynamics in which we study how LMs learn to make factual comparisons between entities, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?
blocks.zh:
语言模型(LM)在预训过程中学到了什么,数据的统计属性如何驱动这些学习动态?
事实证明,数据和模型之间的关系是可解释性研究的沃土,最近的工作揭示了数据的性质如何推动形成结构化的内部代表(Merullo等人,2025年;Karkada等人,2026年;Prieto等人,2026年),算法定律。 (Olsson等人,2022年;Chen等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年),归纳能力(Chan等人,2022年;Chen等人,2024年;Ruis等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年),和不完善的heuristics. (Elazar等人,2022年;He等人,2025年;Kalai等人,2025年)
我们对学习动态进行个案研究,研究LMs如何在实体之间进行事实比较,例如法国和巴西之间,哪个国家更大?

blocks.en:
Answering such questions properly requires retrieving the relevant scalar attributes for each entity (e.g., the area of a country), and performing a numerical comparison between those scalar values ( Elazar et al., 2019 ) .
However, models can instead rely on simpler heuristics, such as the answer’s position in the prompt ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , or how often the answer is mentioned in the training data ( Gottesman et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
Thus, this task provides a natural testbed for understanding (1) when different strategies emerge and disappear throughout training and (2) how entity frequency in pretraining data shapes such learning dynamics.
blocks.zh:
要正确回答这些问题,就必须检索每个实体(例如,一个国家的地区)的相关分级属性,并对这些分级值进行数字比较(Elazar等人,2019年)。
然而,模型却可以依赖更简单的heuristics,比如答案在即时位置(郑等人,2023年),或者在培训数据中多经常提及答案(Gottesman等人,2025年;杨等人,2025年).
因此,这项任务为了解:(1) 当不同的战略在培训过程中出现和消失时,以及(2) 实体在培训前数据中的频率如何塑造这种学习动态提供了自然的试验床。

blocks.en:
To answer the first question, we characterize model behavior throughout training, using three pieces of information: the difference in scalar attributes for each entity pair (the correct algorithm), entity frequency, and positional bias.
We introduce a controlled pretraining setup in which we train GPT-2-scale models (163M parameters) from scratch.
At each training checkpoint, we use a regression model to identify which features best predict model outputs, allowing us to track the evolution of strategies over time.
Our analysis reveals three distinct phases of learning. First, the LM develops a frequency-based heuristic, outputting the entity that has been seen more often in training thus far. Next, a position-based heuristic takes over where the LM outputs either the first- or last-mentioned entity. Finally, the LM learns the correct comparison algorithm
(see Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
为了回答第一个问题,我们用三个信息来描述整个训练过程中的模型行为:每个实体对(正确的算法)的scalar属性差异,实体频率,以及位置偏差.
我们引入了一种控制的预训设置,其中我们从零开始训练GPT-2级模型(163M参数).
在每个培训检查站,我们使用回归模型来确定哪些特征最能预测模型产出,使我们能够跟踪战略随时间推移的演变情况。
我们的分析揭示了三个不同的学习阶段。 首先,LM发展了基于频率的热度,输出了迄今为止在培训中更经常看到的实体. 接下来,基于位置的heuristic接管了LM输出第一个或最后一个实体的地方. 最后,LM学习了正确的比较算法
(见图1)

blocks.en:
We then investigate how properties of the pretraining data drive these learning dynamics ( Section 3 ).
To make the small LM learn the comparison behavior, we supplement natural text from the pretraining corpus with synthetic data, which contains examples of correctly solving the task.
With insufficient synthetic task data, the LM only goes through the first two phases, developing a frequency heuristic then a position heuristic with no further learning.
Increasing the proportion of task data first strengthens positional bias and would more quickly drive the LM to learn the comparison algorithm.
In a second experiment, we vary the distribution of entity frequencies.
Naturally occurring text follows a Zipfian distribution ( Condon, 1928 ) , where a small number of entities are very high frequency while the vast majority of entities are very low frequency; e.g., in the OLMo-2 pretraining corpus, China appears 441M times whereas Luxembourg appears only 6.8M times. We show that we can shorten the duration of the first two phases and temper the strength of the frequency heuristic by using uniform distributions for the synthetic or natural pretraining data.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们调查预训数据的性质如何推动这些学习动态(第3节)。
为了让小的LM学习比较行为,我们用合成数据来补充从预训的自然文本,其中包含了正确解决任务的例子.
由于合成任务数据不足,LM只经过前两个阶段,发展频率heuristic,然后是位置heuristic,没有进一步学习.
增加任务数据的比例首先会强化位置偏差,并会更快地推动LM学习比较算法.
在第二次实验中,我们改变实体频率的分布.
自然出现的文字遵循Zipfian的分布(Condon,1928年),其中少数实体的频率非常高,而绝大多数实体的频率非常低;例如在OLMo-2预训书中,中国出现441M倍,卢森堡出现6.8M倍。 我们显示,我们可以缩短前两个阶段的持续时间,并通过对合成数据或自然预训数据使用统一的分布来降低频率热度的强度。

blocks.en:
Lastly, we then ask whether the same phase structure arises in larger models pretrained on natural text alone, by analyzing checkpoints from the OLMo-2 family (1B, 7B, 13B, and 32B parameters) across all nine tasks ( Section 4 ).
We find the same phases arising in the same order, although which phases appear at all varies with task and model scale.
This suggests that the observed dynamics are not an artifact of the synthetic setup; the resulting phase structure also characterizes pretraining at scale.
Together, our results identify properties of pretraining data as causal drivers of the strategies LMs adopt, showing that they can control which strategies emerge during training and when.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们问同一阶段的结构是否出现在仅靠自然文字就预先训练的较大的模型中,分析所有9项任务(第4节)来自OLMo-2家族(1B、7B、13B和32B参数)的检查站。
我们发现,相同的阶段是按同一顺序出现的,尽管在任务和模型规模方面,究竟出现了哪些阶段。
这表明观测到的动力学并不是合成装置的产物;由此产生的相位结构也具有规模预演的特点.
我们的成果共同确定了预先培训数据的性质,作为 LMs 所采取战略的因果驱动力,表明它们能够控制培训期间和培训时间中出现的战略。

blocks.en: 2 Setup
blocks.zh: 2 设置

blocks.en:
The entity comparison task is defined by triples ( d , e 1 , e 2 ) (d,e_{1},e_{2}) , where e 1 e_{1} and e 2 e_{2} are entities (e.g., countries) and d d is a domain corresponding to a numerical property (e.g., area).
Each entity-domain pair ( d , e ) (d,e) is associated with a scalar value v d , e v_{d,e} .
The algorithm for solving a comparison query 𝒜 ⁡ ( d , e 1 , e 2 ) = max ⁡ ( v d , e 1 , v d , e 2 ) \mathcal{A}(d,e_{1},e_{2})=\max(v_{d,e_{1}},v_{d,e_{2}}) returns the entity with the higher value.
We study nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types: countries, U.S. states, U.S. universities, movies, and notable people.
Each comparison task has two directions, where the correct answer is either the larger or the smaller entity.
We perform pretraining on GPT-2-scale models using three tasks (country area, country GDP, and people birth year), and evaluate OLMo-2 models on all tasks.
The full list of tasks is provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en:
We use subsets of the fully open-source OLMo-2 pretraining corpus, OLMo-mix-1124 ( OLMo et al., 2024 ) , which is used primarily for stage-1 pretraining of OLMo-2 models.
Entity mention frequencies in this corpus follow a heavy-tailed Zipfian distribution, which Figure 2 (a) demonstrates for the country entity.
At the 163M scale, models cannot reliably learn long-tail factual knowledge from natural text alone ( Allen-Zhu and Li, 2023 ; Kandpal et al., 2023 ) , which we also observed in preliminary experiments.
We therefore add synthetic task supervision data as scaffolding: comparison sentences that exactly match the evaluation template, such as “By total area, among the two countries A and B, the larger country is” .
This synthetic data serves as a proxy for the task-relevant signal that larger LMs absorb implicitly from massive pretraining corpora.
We use the full set of entities in both training and evaluation.
This mirrors natural pretraining, where models are exposed to all entities they are later evaluated on, but it also means the LM could memorize the comparisons.
To test this, we run an additional experiment with 20% of entity pairs held out from the synthetic data in Appendix B.5 .

Natural pretraining corpora exhibit heavy-tailed Zipfian entity frequency distributions. In Figure 2 (a), a small set of countries appears very frequently (e.g., United States and France ), while the vast majority appear far less often.
This long-tail pattern is typical for words in natural English text ( Condon, 1928 ; Zipf, 2013 ) .
In our experiments, we manipulate entity frequency separately in synthetic and natural data to study how this naturally occurring distribution affects learning dynamics.

blocks.en: 2.2 Three Phases of Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 三个学习阶段

blocks.en:
To identify which strategies drive LM predictions at each checkpoint during training, we fit a logistic regression model to predict LM outputs from a set of handpicked features, each corresponding to a heuristic or to the correct algorithm.
By comparing regression accuracy across different feature subsets, we can track which strategies are predictive at each checkpoint.
In preliminary experiments, we evaluated a wide range of features (full list in Appendix B.1 ). We found that the best fit uses only three: the frequency, position, and true value of entities. We describe each below, in the order we expect them to dominate over the course of training.
blocks.zh:
为了确定在训练期间每个检查站的LM预测都由哪些战略驱动,我们采用了一个后勤回归模型,从一组手选的特征来预测LM输出,每个特征都对应一个heuristic或正确的算法.
通过比较不同特性子集的回归精度,我们可以追踪每个检查站的预测战略。
在初步实验中,我们评价了广泛的特征(附录B.1中的全部清单)。 我们发现,最合适的方法只使用三个:实体的频率、位置和真正价值。 我们按我们期望他们在训练过程中占主导地位的顺序,逐一描述如下。

blocks.en:
1. Frequency feature: We use the log ratio of cumulative occurrences of e 1 e_{1} and e 2 e_{2} in the training corpus up to step t t : log ⁡ ( count t ​ ( e 1 ) / count t ​ ( e 2 ) ) \log\left(\textsf{count}_{t}(e_{1})/\textsf{count}_{t}(e_{2})\right) . A model relying on this feature is using a popularity heuristic, predicting whichever entity it has seen more often. More broadly, we expect this feature to dominate model predictions early in training, before the model has had sufficient exposure to relevant entities. 2. Positional bias feature: Since the two entities are mentioned sequentially, each can appear in either the first or last position. A model in mid-training may be biased to always output the entity in one of these positions, regardless of where the correct answer is. Since the task is a binary choice, we formalize this bias using the regression intercept, which absorbs any systematic preference for the first- or last-mentioned entity.
Crucially, every entity pair is evaluated in both orderings, so any systematic entity-specific bias, such as frequency, scalar value, or tokenization, is counterbalanced across positions. This ensures that the intercept isolates the model’s residual preference for a prompt position (see Appendix B.2 for verification). 3. Value feature: We use the log ratio of the true values of e 1 e_{1} and e 2 e_{2} in the question domain d d : log ⁡ ( v d , e 1 / v d , e 2 ) \log\left(v_{d,e_{1}}/v_{d,e_{2}}\right) . To characterize which strategies the LM uses at each point in training, we fit the regression features described above and report the drop-one accuracy : the decrease in regression accuracy when a given feature is removed from the predictor set.
This measures the importance of that feature in predicting LM behavior: a large drop-one accuracy for a feature indicates that the model’s outputs are well-explained by that feature at that checkpoint.
We also define the dominant phase at a checkpoint as the phase whose feature has the largest drop-one accuracy at that checkpoint.

这衡量了该特征在预测LM行为方面的重要性:一个特征的一滴精度很大,表明该模型的产出在该检查站得到了很好的解释。
我们还将检查站的主导阶段界定为其特征在该检查站最精确的一级。

blocks.en: 3 Learning Dynamics in Small LMs with Synthetic Data
blocks.zh: 3 带有合成数据的小型 LMs 学习动态

blocks.en:
To study how heuristics develop during training, we start with training small language models from scratch on mixtures of natural text from the OLMo-2 pretraining corpus and synthetic data from the entity comparison task.
First, we vary the amount of synthetic task data relative to natural text and find that, with the right balance of data, three phases of learning emerge: a frequency heuristic first, then a position heuristic, and finally the correct algorithm ( Section 3.1 ).
Then, we change the entity distributions in the training data from Zipfian to uniform and observe how this affects the development of these heuristics ( Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
为了研究在训练期间的热力学发展,我们首先从零开始对OLMo-2预训包中自然文本的混合物和实体比较任务的合成数据进行小语言模型的培训。
首先,我们根据自然文本而改变合成任务数据的数量,发现随着数据的正确平衡,出现了三个学习阶段:先是频率heuristic,然后是位置heuristic,最后是正确的算法(第3.1节).
然后,我们将训练数据中的实体分布从Zipfian改为统一,并观察这如何影响这些heuristic的发展(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 How the Ratio of Synthetic Data Shapes the Three Phases
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 三阶段合成数据的比例如何

blocks.en:
Preliminary experiments demonstrated that the 163M-parameter LMs do not learn the comparison task when trained on only natural data, which is unsurprising at this scale.
To help the model learn the behavior we want to study, we supplement natural text in the pretraining corpora with synthetic task-specific data. For the country area task, it follows the form “By total area, among the two countries A and B, the larger country is ” .
Under a fixed total data budget of 1.1B tokens, we vary the proportion of synthetic task supervision in 0%, 0.01%, 0.1%, and 1%.
We generate synthetic data that matches the Zipfian distribution so that it better mirrors naturally occurring text.
The fully natural setting serves as a control, which allows us to observe the effect of natural text on model behavior.
blocks.zh:
初步实验表明,163M参数的LMs在只接受自然数据培训时,并不会学习比较任务,而这种规模并不奇怪。
为了帮助模型学习我们想要研究的行为,我们用合成任务特定数据来补充训练前蝎子中的自然文本. 就国别任务而言,它采用的形式是“在A国和B国中,面积较大的国家......”。
根据1.1B令牌的固定总数据预算,我们以0%、0.01%、0.1%和1%来改变合成任务监督的比例。
我们生成与Zipfian分布相匹配的合成数据,以便它更好地反映自然出现的文本。
完全自然的设定是一种控制,它使我们能够观察自然文本对模型行为的影响.

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Learning trajectories across four ratios of synthetic task data to Zipfian natural text (0%, 0.01%, 0.1%, 1%).
Solid lines and dark shaded regions show mean and standard deviation across 3 training seeds. The frequency phase is invariant to task supervision, but the correct algorithm phase only emerges above a critical density. Below this density (0%, 0.01%), the model never reaches the correct algorithm and instead defaults to positional shortcuts.
blocks.zh:
图3:合成任务数据与Zipfian自然文本的四种比例的学习轨迹(0%、0.01%、0.1%、1%)。
固体线和暗荫区域显示3个训练种子的平均值和标准偏差。 频率相对于任务监督来说是变化无常的,但正确的算法相只在临界密度上方出现. 在这一密度(0%,0.01%)以下,模型从未达到正确的算法,而是默认定位快捷键.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows that the frequency phase is essentially identical across all four conditions: it peaks at step 200 and decays by step 1K, regardless of synthetic ratio.
This motivates the experiments in the next section (§ 3.2 ), where we show that the frequency phase depends on the entity frequency distribution of the training data, and that flattening that distribution weakens the phase.
blocks.zh:
图3显示,在所有四个条件中,频率相基本相同:在200步时达到峰值,在1K步时发生衰变,无论合成比例如何.
这激发了下一节(§3.2)中的实验,我们显示频率相取决于训练数据的实体频率分布,而平整这种分布会削弱相.

blocks.en:
The difference across conditions is whether the model ever reaches the correct algorithm.
At 0% and 0.01% synthetic data, the correct-algorithm feature stays near zero throughout training.
At 0.1%, it emerges around 2.5K steps and rises steadily.
When task data is increased to 1%, it emerges within the first 1K steps and reaches a drop-one accuracy of 18 18 by end of training.
This corroborates existing work and suggests that there is a threshold: below a critical density of task-relevant signal, the model never finds learning the task loss-reducing enough to override existing shortcuts ( Gu et al., 2025 ; Verma et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
不同条件的差异在于模型是否达到正确的算法.
在0和0.01%的合成数据中,正确算法特征在整个训练期间保持接近0.
以0.1%的速度出现,约2.5K级,并稳步上升.
当任务数据增加到1%时,它出现在前1K步骤中,并在培训结束时达到18-18的下降精度。
这证实了现有的工作,并表明存在一个阈值:在与任务有关的信号的关键密度以下,模型从未发现学习任务损失的减少足以超越现有的捷径(Gu等人,2025年;Verma等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: When the correct algorithm phase does not emerge (0% and 0.01%), model behavior converges to a strong positional bias that persists throughout the rest of training. At 0.1%, a shorter position phase still appears between the frequency and correct-algorithm phases. At 1%, the position phase is absent as the model jumps directly from frequency to solving the task correctly.
blocks.zh: 当正确的算法阶段没有出现(0%和0.01%)时,模型行为会形成强烈的位置偏差,这在其余训练中一直存在. 在0.1%时,频率与正确算法相之间仍会出现一个较短的位置相. 在1%时,由于模型从频率直接跳到正确解决任务,位置相位缺失.

blocks.en: 3.2 How Entity Frequency Distribution Drives the Heuristic Phases
blocks.zh: 3.2 实体频率分配如何推动高压阶段

blocks.en:
With 0.1% of synthetic task data, we observe the three-phase learning dynamics emerge in training.
However, the previous experiments use synthetic data with entity frequency distributions that match the Zipfian distribution of naturally occurring data.
Now, we separately manipulate the entity frequency distribution and change from Zipfian to uniform.
We run this experiment on three tasks, country area and country GDP comparison presented in the main paper, and person birth year in Appendix C.2 . For each task, we train a separate model for each of the four natural vs. synthetic distribution combinations.
To construct the uniform setting, we sample sequences that contain country or people mentions to achieve roughly uniform mentions per entity.
blocks.zh:
有了0.1%的合成任务数据,我们观测到培训中出现的三阶段学习动态。
然而,之前的实验使用与自然发生的数据的Zipfian分布相匹配的实体频率分布的合成数据.
现在,我们分别操控实体的频率分布,从Zipfian改为统一.
我们进行这项试验是为了完成以下三项任务:主要论文中介绍的国别地区和国家的国内生产总值比较;附录C.2中介绍的出生年份。 每一项任务,我们都会为四个自然对合成分配组合中每个组合训练一个单独的模型.
为了构建统一设置,我们抽样抽查包含国家或人提到的序列,以实现每个实体大致统一的提及。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Learning trajectories for country area (left) and country GDP (right) across four combinations of natural text and synthetic data distributions (Zipfian × \times Uniform). Both tasks show the same frequency, position, correct algorithm ordering. The frequency phase is strongest when natural text is Zipfian. Solid lines and shaded regions show mean and standard deviation across 3 seeds.
blocks.zh: 图4:国家地区(左)和国家GDP(右)的学习轨迹,分为自然文本和合成数据分布(Zipfian ×\times Uniform)四个组合. 两个任务都显示相同的频率,位置,正确的算法命令. 当自然文字为Zipfian时,频率相差最强. 固体线和阴影区域显示3个种子的平均值和标准偏差。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows the learning trajectories for country area
(left) and country GDP (right).
In each block, the columns vary the entity distribution of the natural text (Zipfian or uniform), and the rows vary the distribution of the synthetic data.
When natural text is Zipfian (first column of each block), both tasks show a strong early frequency phase, regardless of the synthetic distribution.
When natural text is uniform, this phase is much weaker, and it nearly disappears when both natural text and synthetic data are uniform.
The correct algorithm shows the opposite pattern. When both distributions are uniform (bottom right of each block), it emerges earliest and reaches its largest drop-one accuracy. When both are Zipfian (top left), it is weakest.
blocks.zh:
图4显示国别学习轨迹
(左)与国产总值(右).
在每个块中,列会改变自然文本的实体分布(Zipfian或uniform),列会改变合成数据的分布.
当自然文本是Zipfian(每个块的第一列)时,无论合成分布如何,这两个任务都显示出强烈的早期频率相.
当自然文本是统一的时,这个阶段要弱得多,当自然文本和合成数据都是统一的时,它就几乎消失.
正确的算法显示了相反的模式. 当两种分布均匀(每个区块的下方右下方)时,它会最早出现并达到其最大的滴精度. 当两者均为Zipfian(左上)时,最弱.

blocks.en:
Grouping entity pairs by the ratio of the correct entity’s frequency to that of the incorrect one, we find that this bias persists beyond the initial phase.
In Figure 5 , a ratio below 1 indicates that the correct answer is the less frequent entity; a ratio above 1 indicates that it is the more frequent one.
Early in training, accuracy is high only when the correct answer is substantially more frequent than the incorrect one.
While this bias gradually diminishes, the model still maintains higher accuracy on pairs where the correct answer is more frequent in late training stages.
blocks.zh:
根据正确实体的频率与不正确实体的频率之比进行分组,我们发现这种偏差在初始阶段之后依然存在。
在图5中,低于1的比例表明正确的答案是频率较低的实体;高于1的比例表明它是频率较高的实体。
培训初期,只有在正确答案比错误答案频繁得多时,准确度才很高。
虽然这种偏差逐渐减弱,但模型在对子上仍然保持更高的精度,在后期训练阶段正确答案更加频繁.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Accuracy by entity frequency ratio (correct / incorrect entity) across training steps under Zipfian data. Early in training, accuracy is high only when the correct answer is much more frequent, which corresponds to the frequency bias phase. Throughout training, accuracy is consistently higher when the correct entity is more frequent than when it is less frequent.
blocks.zh: 图5:Zipfian数据下各培训步骤按实体频率比率(正确/不正确实体)分列的准确性。 训练初期,只有在正确答案更频繁时,准确度才会很高,这与频率偏差阶段相对应. 在整个培训中,当正确的实体比较低的实体更频繁时,准确性一直较高。

blocks.en: 4 Learning Dynamics in OLMo Pretraining
blocks.zh: 4 OLMo预训的学习动态

blocks.en:
The controlled experiments in Section 3 establish that the Zipfian distribution of entities in text drives the frequency heuristic phase, and that training on such corpora follows a three-phase structure.
We now ask whether the same pattern appears in models trained at scale on natural text alone, without any synthetic task supervision.
blocks.zh:
第3节中的受控实验证实,Zipfian在文本中实体的分布驱动频率热度阶段,关于这种公司的培训遵循三阶段结构。
我们现在问,同样的模式是否出现在仅仅对自然文本进行大规模培训的模型中,而没有任何综合任务监督。

blocks.en:
We focus on the OLMo-2 model family (1B, 7B, 13B, and 32B) ( Groeneveld et al., 2024 ) , which provides fully open-sourced training data and checkpoints.
We apply the same regression analysis as described in Section 2 to track which strategy dominates over time.
We evaluate 26 checkpoints per model, focusing primarily on stage 1 pretraining, with dense early coverage (every 1K steps from 1K to 10K) and sparser, log-spaced checkpoints afterward.
To account for prompt variation, we evaluate each checkpoint with 3 prompt templates and report mean and standard deviation across them.
The checkpoints and prompts used are presented in Appendix D .
We structure this analysis in two parts. First, we track the country area task across all four model sizes to observe how learning dynamics change with scale ( Figure 6 ). Since the smaller models do not reliably learn the task, we then focus on the 32B model and extend the analysis to all nine comparison tasks, in both directions, to test how well the phase structure generalizes ( Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh:
我们专注于OLMo-2模式家族(1B,7B,13B,32B). (Groeneveld等人,2024年),提供完全开源的培训数据和检查站。
我们采用第2节所述的同样的回归分析,以跟踪哪些战略在一段时间内占主导地位。
我们评价每个模式的26个检查站,主要侧重于第一阶段的预训,早期覆盖密集(每1K步从1K步到10K步),之后的检查站数量比较少,有日志。
为了考虑到迅速的变化,我们用3个快速模板对每个检查站进行评价,并报告它们之间的平均和标准偏差。
使用的检查站和便条见附录D。
我们把这个分析分为两部分。 首先,我们跟踪所有四个模式规模的国别地区任务,以观察学习动态如何随规模变化(图6)。 由于较小的模型无法可靠地了解任务,我们然后将重点放在32B模型上,并将分析扩展到所有九个比较任务,双向,以测试阶段结构的概括程度(图7)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Phase Structure Across Model Scales
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 跨模型缩放的阶段结构

blocks.en:
In Figure 6 , all four models exhibit the early heuristic phases observed in our controlled experiments, and they emerge in the order of frequency followed by position.
The frequency heuristic appears briefly in the earliest checkpoint of all models.
The 1B and 7B models then remain in a prolonged position heuristic phase without learning the task;
the 13B model transitions to the correct algorithm at around 1T tokens, while the 32B model does so earlier and achieves a higher peak.
We notice that the frequency phase has a lower peak than in the small LMs we pretrained, and hypothesize that this is because the first available checkpoint is already several billion tokens into training. A more pronounced frequency phase may have occurred before this point.
To check this, we rerun the official OLMo-2 1B stage-1 training from initialization for the first 1,000 steps (Appendix D.1 ). Frequency is already the dominant phase within the first 200 steps for most of our nine comparison tasks, supporting that the frequency phase begins before the first public checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
在图6中,所有四种模型都显示了在我们控制的实验中观测到的早期热度阶段,它们以频率的顺序出现,然后是位置。
频率heuristic在所有型号的最早检查站中短暂出现.
1B型和7B型机车随后处于长时间的休眠状态,没有学习任务;
13B模型在1T令牌左右向正确的算法过渡,而32B模型更早地这样做,并实现了更高的峰值.
我们注意到,频率阶段的峰值低于我们预先训练过的小型LMs,并假设这是因为第一个检查站已经是数十亿个用于训练的标志。 此时之前可能已经发生了更显著的频段.
为了检查这一点,我们从初始化开始重新运行正式的OLMo-2 1B阶段-1训练,用于前1000步(附录D.1. 频率已经是我们九个比较任务中大多数前200个步骤中的主要阶段,支持频率阶段在第一个公共检查站之前开始。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Feature importance across training checkpoints for OLMo-2 1B, 7B, 13B, and 32B. Solid lines and shaded regions show mean and standard deviation across 3 prompt variations per checkpoint. All models show frequency and position heuristics appearing in order, consistent with the phases observed in the controlled GPT-2 experiments. Smaller OLMo-2 models never learn the task.
blocks.zh: 图6:OLMo-2 1B、7B、13B和32B的训练检查站的特色重要性。 实线和阴影区域显示每个检查站有3个快速变化的平均值和标准偏差。 所有模型都显示频率和位置湿度,与受控的GPT-2实验中观察到的阶段相一致。 更小的OLMo-2型型号从不学习任务.

blocks.en:
The correct algorithm phase emerges only in the two larger models, at 1T tokens for the 13B model and 400B tokens for 32B.
In the two smaller models, the value feature stays near zero throughout training, meaning that they never learn the task.
This parallels the threshold finding from the synthetic settings in Section 3.1 : just as the correct algorithm fails to emerge below a critical density of task supervision in small-scale models, here it fails to emerge below a critical model size.
Natural pretraining text contains relatively sparse task signal for entity comparison, and at 1B and 7B parameters the model lacks the capacity to learn the task.
blocks.zh:
正确的算法阶段只在两个更大的模型中出现,分别为13B模型的1T令牌和32B的400B令牌.
在两个较小的模型中,价值特征在整个训练期间都保持接近零,这意味着他们从未学习过任务.
这与第3.1节中合成设置的阈值发现类似:正如正确的算法未能在小型模型中任务监督的临界密度下出现一样,它也未能在临界模型尺寸下出现.
自然预训文本中包含相对稀少的任务信号用于实体比较,在1B和7B参数上,模型缺乏学习任务的能力.

blocks.en: 4.2 Generalization Across Nine Comparison Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.2 跨越九个比较任务的概括

blocks.en:
To test how broadly the phase structure generalizes, we extend the analysis to all nine comparison tasks, in both the larger- and smaller-magnitude directions (18 task variants in total).
We focus on OLMo-2 32B, since early experiments show that the smaller models (especially 1B and 7B) do not reliably learn the tasks by the end of stage 1 pretraining.
blocks.zh:
为了测试阶段结构的概括程度,我们把分析扩大到所有9项比较任务,包括大尺寸和小尺寸方向(总共18项任务变体)。
我们专注于OLMo-2 32B,因为早期的实验表明,较小的模型(特别是1B和7B)在第一阶段预训结束时无法可靠地学习任务.

blocks.en:
Figure 7 shows the dominant phase at four selected checkpoints: the first available checkpoint (9B tokens seen), two intermediate checkpoints, and the final checkpoint (5000B tokens seen) at the end of stage 1 pretraining. Full results for all checkpoints are in Appendix D.2 .
At the earliest checkpoint (9B tokens), frequency is the dominant phase in 15 of the 18 task variants.
This includes 8 of the 9 smaller-magnitude variants, where selecting the more frequent entity is typically incorrect. This suggests that the early phase reflects entity frequency statistics rather than partial task knowledge.
blocks.zh:
图7显示四个选定的检查站的主导阶段:第一个可用的检查站(看到9B个标志)、两个中间检查站和第一阶段预训结束时的最后检查站(看到5 000B个标志)。 所有检查站的全面结果载于附录D.2。
在最早的检查站(9B令牌),频率是18个任务变体中15个中的主要阶段.
这包括9个较小宽度变体中的8个,其中选择更频繁的实体通常不正确。 这表明,早期阶段反映的是实体频率统计而不是部分任务知识。

blocks.en: Which phases appear varies by task, since for some tasks even the 32B model struggles to learn the correct algorithm. However, the relative order of the three phases is more consistent: across the training trajectory, whenever two phases both become dominant, they largely follow the frequency, position, value order.
blocks.zh: 哪个阶段的出现因任务而异,因为对于某些任务,甚至32B模型也难以学习正确的算法. 然而,三个阶段的相对顺序更为一致:在整个训练轨迹中,每当两个阶段都成为主导阶段时,它们基本上遵循频率,位置,价值顺序.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Dominant phase for OLMo-2 32B across all 18 task variants at four stage-1 checkpoints (9B, 84B, 1T, and 5T tokens). Each cell is colored by the feature with the largest drop-one accuracy at that checkpoint, and the number is that feature’s drop-one accuracy (%). Left: larger-magnitude comparisons; right: smaller-magnitude comparisons. Frequency dominates the earliest checkpoint for most variants, and later phases largely follow the frequency–position–value structure.
blocks.zh: 图7: OLMo-2 32B在4个一级检查站(9B、84B、1T和5T令牌)的所有18个任务变体的主导阶段。 每个单元格的颜色都由该检查点最精准的投球特性组成,数字是该特征的投球精确度(%)。 左:大度对比;右:小度对比. 在大多数变种中,频率是最早的检查站,以后的阶段主要遵循频率-位置-价值结构。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Across scales from 163M to 32B parameters, models exhibit the same heuristic phases, and the 1B and 7B OLMo models never escape the positional heuristic.
These heuristics appear to be a structural feature of how the task is learned, rather than an artifact of small or synthetic data.
The key difference is whether the model successfully transitions out of these heuristics, not whether the heuristics emerge.
In controlled experiments, the correct algorithm fails to emerge below a critical density of task supervision; in OLMo, it fails to emerge below a critical model scale on natural text alone.
This is in line with prior work sugesting that the correct strategy only becomes loss reducing once the model has sufficient task-relevant signal relative to its capacity.
Practically, our results indicate that the long tail in natural pretraining corpora may impose a real cost on downstream task acquisition.
Flattening these heavy-tailed distributions in pretraining corpora can make learning more efficient.
blocks.zh:
跨尺度从163M到32B参数,模型表现出相同的热度阶段,1B和7B的OLMo模型永远无法逃脱位置热度.
这些推力论似乎是该任务如何学习的结构性特征,而不是小数据或合成数据的文物.
关键区别在于模型是否成功过渡出这些heuristic,而不是heuristics是否出现.
在受控实验中,正确的算法未能在任务监督的临界密度下出现;在OLMo中,它未能在仅自然文本上的关键模型尺度下出现.
这与先前的工作推波助澜一致,即正确的策略只有在模型相对于其能力具有足够的与任务相关的信号后才会变成减少损失.
实际上,我们的结果表明,自然预训中的长尾巴可能对下游任务购置造成实际成本。
将这些重尾部分布在训练前的蝎子中,可以提高学习效率.

blocks.en:
We observe three phases in learning: first a frequency heuristic, then a position heuristic, and finally the correct algorithm.
The consistency of this ordering across very different settings suggests that it reflects a structural property of the task: each phase corresponds to the easiest-to-learn predictive feature given the model’s current state.
Frequency is directly available from token-level statistics, position depends on syntactic patterns in the data, and value-based entity comparison requires manipulating factual knowledge.
Each subsequent strategy is likely more expensive to learn, but eventually becomes more loss reducing than its predecessor.
blocks.zh:
我们观察了学习的三个阶段:先是频率热度,然后是位置热度,最后是正确的算法。
在不同环境之间这种顺序的一致性表明,它反映了任务的结构属性:鉴于模型的现状,每个阶段都对应最容易学习的预测特征。
频率直接从符号级统计中获得,位置取决于数据中的合成规律,基于价值的实体比较需要操纵事实知识.
以后的每一个策略都可能比其前身更昂贵的学习,但最终会比前身更减少损失.

blocks.en:
We focus our experiments on the task of entity comparison, and the observed phase structure may not generalize to tasks with different structures.
Our controlled experiments are conducted at the 163M scale in order to efficiently vary data composition and perform model pretraining under feasible compute budgets, which would otherwise be infeasible for large-scale pretraining.
Although these intervention experiments are small-scale, we show that the toy setting can nevertheless provide insight into the training dynamics of much larger models, which is itself an interesting finding.
While our OLMo-2 analysis suggests that the same phases emerge at much larger scales, we cannot establish causal evidence for the role of data at scale.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验侧重于实体比较的任务,所观察到的相位结构可能无法概括为不同结构的任务.
我们的受控试验是在163M规模上进行的,以便有效地改变数据构成,并在可行的计算预算下进行模型预训,否则就不适合大规模预训。
尽管这些干预实验是小规模的,但我们表明,玩具的设置可以提供对更大模型培训动态的洞察,这本身就是一个有趣的发现。
虽然我们的OLMo-2分析表明,在更大的尺度上也会出现同样的阶段,但我们不能为大规模数据的作用确定因果关系。

blocks.en:
Lastly, our experiments that modify pretraining data statistics (e.g., changing the country distribution from Zipfian to uniform) require re-selecting sequences containing the target entities. For example, this may involve excluding sequences heavily focused on United States politics while selecting sequences about tropical fruits in Madagascar.
This process could introduce domain shifts and other confounding factors that we do not account for.
There is currently no straightforward solution to this issue, and it remains an active open research problem ( Nadkarni et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
最后,我们修改预先培训数据统计的实验(例如,将国家分布从Zipfian改为统一)需要重新选择包含目标实体的序列。 例如,这可能涉及在马达加斯加选择热带水果的序列时,排除高度注重美国政治的序列。
这一过程可以引入我们不考虑的领域转移和其他令人困惑的因素。
目前这个问题没有直接的解决办法,它仍然是一个积极的公开研究问题(Nadkarni等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
We would like to understand the underlying mechanisms for each heuristic and more fully trace the origins of the three phases in this order.
For example, whether the positional bias relies on induction-head-style in-context retrieval and if it relates to when induction heads are formed, and whether there exists latent representations that track entity frequency.
blocks.zh:
我们想了解每个休戚与共的基本机制,并更充分地追溯这三个阶段的起源。
例如,职位偏差是否依赖于上岗-头型内文检索,是否与上岗主管形成时有关,是否存在跟踪实体频率的潜在表示.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
LMs often rely on heuristics rather than the intended algorithms for solving tasks.
Prior work has identified shortcuts in natural language inference ( McCoy et al., 2019 ) , arithmetic reasoning ( Razeghi et al., 2022 ; Nikankin et al., 2025 ) , multi-hop reasoning ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and factual recall, where entity popularity sharply predicts whether a model answers correctly ( Mallen et al., 2023 ; Kandpal et al., 2023 ) .
Most closely related to our setting, Lehmann et al. (2026) study entity comparison in fully trained LLMs and identify three heuristic biases that influence predictions.
A complementary view characterizes LM behavior as a mixture of strategies rather than a single mechanism ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Gur-Arieh et al., 2025 ; Pîslar et al., 2025 ; Todd et al., 2025 ) . These analyses operate on static checkpoints; we instead study the learning trajectory itself, asking when each heuristic emerges during training and what data properties drive its emergence.
blocks.zh:
LMs经常依靠休眠法而不是预期的算法来解决任务.
先前的工作确定了自然语言推论的捷径(McCoy等人,2019年),算术推理(Razeghi等人,2022年;Nikankin等人,2025年),多跳推理(Yang等人,2025年),以及事实上的回忆,实体的受欢迎程度尖锐地预测模型答案是否正确(Mallen等人,2023年;Kandpal等人,2023年).
Lehmann等人(2026年)研究实体在经过充分培训的法学硕士中进行比较,并找出影响预测的三个热力偏差。
一种补充观点将LM行为定性为战略的混合而非单一机制(Wu等人,2025年;Gur-Arieh等人,2025年;Pîslar等人,2025年;Todd等人,2025年)。 这些分析是在静态检查站进行的;我们研究学习的轨迹本身,询问在培训期间,每一次修炼活动何时出现,以及何种数据特性促使其出现。

blocks.en:
Pretraining data affects model behavior, performance, and internal representations ( Elazar et al., 2022 ; McCoy et al., 2023 ; Shaib et al., 2024 ; Merullo et al., 2025 ; Ruis et al., 2025 ; Verma et al., 2025 ) . Wang et al. (2025) measure the correlation between LLM output probabilities and the frequency of task-relevant n-gram pairs in pretraining data, while other work has traced model biases and failures to asymmetries in entity frequency ( Razeghi et al., 2022 ; He et al., 2025 ; Kandpal et al., 2023 ; Mallen et al., 2023 ) .
To make causal claims about data effects, prior work has intervened directly on training data composition ( Wei et al., 2021 ; Chan et al., 2022 ; Allen-Zhu and Li, 2024 ) ; Nadkarni et al. (2025) provide a recipe for document-level interventions, and Longpre et al. (2024) systematically study effects of data age, domain coverage, and quality.
Our work builds on this interventional methodology and identifies entity distribution as a causal driver of which heuristic phases emerge during training.
blocks.zh:
预训数据影响模型行为、性能和内部表现 (Elazar等人,2022年;McCoy等人,2023年;Shaib等人,2024年;Merullo等人,2025年;Ruis等人,2025年;Verma等人,2025年) Wang等人(2025年)测量了LLM输出概率与任务相关n克对在预训数据中的频率之间的关联性,而其他工作则追溯到模型偏差和实体频率不对称的失败(Razeghi等人,2022年;He等人,2025年;Kandpal等人,2023年;Mallen等人,2023年).
为了就数据影响提出因果关系主张,先前的工作直接干预了培训数据构成(Wei等人,2021年;Chan等人,2022年;Allen-Zhu和Li,2024年);Nadkarni等人,2025年)为文件层面的干预提供了食谱,Longpre等人. (2024)系统研究数据时代,域覆盖范围和质量的影响.
我们的工作以这一干预方法为基础,确定实体分布是培训过程中出现高压阶段的因果驱动力。

blocks.en:
Capabilities are often acquired during pretraining through abrupt transitions or distinct phases that build on earlier representations ( Saphra and Lopez, 2019 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
A canonical case study is the formation of induction heads, which coincides with a sharp drop in loss and the emergence of in-context learning ( Olsson et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2024 ) .
Other work tracks how the internal mechanisms behind a capability change over training: the attention heads implementing a circuit can be replaced over time while the algorithm they implement stays the same ( Tigges et al., 2024 ) , and components can shift from general-purpose to task-specific as a model gets better at predicting an answer ( Hakimi et al., 2025 ) .
Closest to our setting, Zucchet et al. (2025) also find that factual recall emerges in distinct phases, with a plateau before precise recall that shortens under more balanced training data; Chang et al. (2024) similarly study how factual knowledge is acquired and forgotten over the course of pretraining. Ravfogel et al. (2025) trace the emergence of a linear truth direction, and Gu et al. (2025) study phase transitions as a function of data mixing ratio.
Our work extends this perspective to natural pretraining data statistics.
blocks.zh:
能力往往是在训练前通过突然过渡或不同阶段获得的,这些过渡或不同阶段是建立在先前的表述基础上的(Saphra和Lopez, 2019年;Chen等人, 2024年;Wu等人, 2025年)。
犬科的案例研究是上岗头的形成,这与损失的锐减和内文学习的出现同时发生(Olsson等人,2022年;Singh等人,2024年).
其他工作跟踪能力变化背后的内部机制如何超越培训:执行电路的注意力头可以随时间而更换,而其执行的算法则保持不变(Tigges等人,2024年),组件可以随着模型更能预测答案而从通用转向特定任务(Hakimi等人,2025年)。
与我们的情况最接近的是,Zucchet等人(2025年)也发现事实召回是在不同的阶段出现的,在准确召回之前有一个高原,根据更平衡的培训数据缩短了时间;Chang等人。 (2024年)同样研究在预训过程中如何获得和遗忘事实知识. Ravfogel等人(2025年)追踪线性真理方向的出现,以及Gu等人. (2025)研究阶段过渡作为数据混合比函数.
我们的工作将这一视角扩展到自然预先培训数据统计。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We identify three phases of learning in entity comparison and show through controlled experiments that pretraining data composition causally determines which phases emerge and when.
The same phase structure appears in OLMo-2 models trained on natural text at scales up to 32B parameters, suggesting these dynamics are a general feature of how LMs learn this task.
Our results highlight pretraining data statistics as both a driver of heuristic learning and a controllable lever for studying it.
blocks.zh:
我们确定在实体比较中学习的三个阶段,并通过控制下的实验显示,预先训练数据构成因果决定了哪个阶段出现和何时出现。
同样的相位结构出现在OLMo-2模型中,这些模型以不超过32B参数的尺度对自然文本进行培训,这表明这些动态是LMs如何学习这项任务的一个一般特征.
我们的成果突出表明,预先培训数据统计既是助推热力学习的动力,也是研究这种知识的可控杠杆。

blocks.en: Appendix B Feature Ablation Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: B.1 List of Evaluated Features
blocks.zh: B.1 评价特征清单

blocks.en:
To identify the strategies that LMs use for the entity comparison task, we evaluate a wide range of features in initial experiments.
For each input triple ( d , e 1 , e 2 ) (d,e_{1},e_{2}) , we construct a feature vector ϕ ⁡ ( d , e 1 , e 2 ) \phi(d,e_{1},e_{2}) to capture relevant features that correspond to possible heuristics. We consider four families of features: 1. Positional bias feature : binary indicators of left/right position, independent of entity semantics or values (e.g., whether e 1 e_{1} is favored by virtue of being mentioned first). This is the intercept in the logistic regression model. 2. Frequency-based features : entity occurrence and co-occurrence counts in the pretraining corpus (e.g., sum of the occurrences of e 1 e_{1} and e 2 e_{2} ). 3. Value-based features : variants of the numerical values v d , e 1 v_{d,e_{1}} and v d , e 2 v_{d,e_{2}} , including absolute values, log-scaled values, differences, and ratios. 4. Related-domain features : values of numerical properties other than d d that may co-vary with v d , e v_{d,e} (e.g., population or GDP when d d is area), intended to test whether models rely on these correlated proxies.
blocks.zh:
为了确定LMS用于实体比较任务的战略,我们评价了初步实验中的广泛特征.
对于每个输入三进制(d, e 1, e 2) (d, e_{1}, e_{2}), 我们构造一个特性矢量 φ(d, e 1, e 2)\phi(d, e_{1}, e_{2}) , 以捕捉与可能的修炼相应的相关特性. 我们认为有四个特点的家庭: 1. 位置偏差特征 : 左/右位置的二进制指标,独立于实体语义或值(例如,e 1 e_{1}是否因为被先提及而得到偏好). 这是后勤回归模型的拦截 2. 基于频率的特征:在预训书中实体发生和共同发生数(例如,e 1 e_{1}和e 2 e_{2}的总和)。 3. 以价值为基础的特性:数字值的变体v d, e 1 v_{d, e_{1}} 和 v d, e 2 v_{d, e_{2}} , 包括绝对值, 对数尺度值, 差异, 和比率. 4. 相关领域特征 :dd以外的可能与vd, ev_{d,e}(如当dd是区域时的人口或GDP)共同对应的数字属性值,意在测试模型是否依赖于这些相关代词.

B.2 Validating Positional Bias Feature
blocks.zh: B.2 验证位置特征

blocks.en:
Because every entity pair is evaluated in both prompt orders ( Section 2 ), we can classify each unordered pair into one of four categories: the model chooses whichever entity appears first , regardless of which entity that is; the model chooses whichever entity appears second ; the model chooses the correct entity in both orderings; or the model chooses the incorrect entity in both orderings.
A strong position drop-one accuracy should correspond to a large share of pairs falling into the first two categories, while a stable entity-specific bias (e.g., from frequency, value, or tokenization) would instead fall into the last two categories. Table 3 reports this breakdown for task and checkpoint combinations that have strong position drop-one accuracy, together with country area at a late checkpoint where the position bias is weak, as a contrast.
blocks.zh:
因为每个实体配对在两个即时命令(第2节)中都被评价,所以我们可以将每个未排序的配对归为四个类别之一:模型选择哪个实体先出现,不管哪个实体是哪个实体;模型选择哪个实体第二出现;模型在两个命令中选择正确的实体;或者模型在两个命令中选择不正确的实体.
强烈的姿势投放精度应该对应掉入前两类的一对大比例,而稳定的实体特定偏差(例如,从频率,值,或标注)则属于后两类. 表3报告任务和检查站组合的细目,这些组合的定位精确度很高,而位置偏差较弱的较晚检查站的国家区域则与此相对照。

blocks.en:
When the position feature has high drop-one accuracy, most unordered pairs fall into the first position or second position categories: the model’s chosen entity changes when the prompt order is reversed, which confirms that the intercept is capturing order dependence rather than a stable entity-specific preference.
In the last row where the position feature is weak, the large majority of pairs fall into the always correct category, meaning that the a model that has moved past the position heuristic.

当位置特征具有高的滴入精度时,大多数无序对子都属于第一个位置或第二个位置类别:模型选择的实体在即时命令倒转时会改变,这证实了截取是捕捉命令依赖,而不是稳定的实体特定偏好.

blocks.en: B.5 Evaluation on Holdout Data
blocks.zh: B.5 关于搁置数据的评价

blocks.en:
The controlled pretraining experiments in Section 3 train and evaluate on all country entities.
To check that the correct algorithm phase is not an artifact of memorization, we additionally train a 163M small LM with 1% Zipfian synthetic data, but restrict synthetic comparison statements to a random 80% of country pairs.
The remaining 20% country pairs (4,644 out of 23,220 pairs) never appear in the synthetic data during training.
We then evaluate on the holdout pairs only, so the model has never seen that specific comparison. Figure 16 shows that the value feature rises in late training to a level comparable to that of in-distribution pairs.
blocks.zh:
第3节中受控的预训试验对所有国家实体进行培训和评价。
为了检查正确的算法阶段不是记忆化的文物,我们额外训练了具有1%的Zipfian合成数据的163M小LM,但将合成比较声明限制在随机的80%的国对.
其余20%的国家对(23 220对中的4 644对)在培训期间从未出现在合成数据中。
然后,我们只评估悬空对子, 所以模型从来没有见过这种具体的比较。 图16显示,在晚期培训中,价值特征上升到相当于分配配对的水平。

blocks.en:
The GPT-2-scale small LMs are trained on 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with bfloat16 mixed precision, which takes roughly two hours for 7,560 training steps.

blocks.en: Here, we describe the data compositions for training the small LMs in each controlled setup.

blocks.en: For experiments in Section 3.1 , we hold the data distributions of natural and synthetic text fixed to Zipfian (matching the OLMo-mix-1124 distribution) and vary only the ratio of natural to synthetic text. To reach a target amount of synthetic data, we tile the synthetic comparison statements until they sum to the desired token count. We fill the rest of the token budget with natural text data sampled from OLMo-mix-1124 . The exact token splits used in each run are listed in Table 4 .

Figure 17: Visualizes the frequency distributions of country entities in each controlled pretraining condition.
For each panel, the x-axis is the number of times a country has been mentioned so far in training, and the y-axis is how many countries have been mentioned at least that many times (both axes on a log scale). Each line is one checkpoint, from early (dark purple) to late (yellow) training; lines move to the right as mentions accumulate. blocks.en: C.2 People Birth Year Comparison
blocks.zh: C.2 人口出生年份比较

blocks.en:
Figure 18 shows the learning trajectories of the people birth year task under each of the four data mix conditions.
We observe that when the synthetic data is Zipfian, there is a strong early frequency phase until around step 1000, but this frequency phase becomes weaker when the synthetic data is uniform.
One possible explanation is that people are mentioned less often than countries in natural pretraining text (i.e., in the Zipfian natural text we use, the most and least frequently mentioned people have 9,598 and 0 mentions respectively, while the corresponding counts for countries are 165,998 and 26). As a result, the long tail in the synthetic data could affect learning more strongly.
blocks.zh:
图18显示了在四个数据组合条件中每个条件下人们出生年任务的学习轨迹。
我们观测到,当合成数据是Zipfian时,有一个很强的早期频率相直到1000步左右,但当合成数据统一时,这个频率相变弱.
一种可能的解释是,在自然预训文本中,人们被提及的次数少于国家(即在我们使用的Zipfian自然文本中,最常被提及的人分别有9 598人和0人,而国家的相应数字为165 998人和26人)。 因此,合成数据中的长尾可能更强烈地影响学习.

blocks.en: D.1 Training OLMo-2 1B from Initialization

blocks.en:
The earliest publicly released OLMo-2 checkpoint is already several billion tokens into training (e.g., the first OLMo-2 1B checkpoint, at step 1000, has already seen approximately 3B tokens), so the frequency phase documented in Section 4 may be partially cut off.
A stronger frequency phase could occur even earlier. To check this directly, we rerun the OLMo-2 1B stage-1 training recipe from random initialization until 1000 steps.

最早公开发布的OLMo-2检查站已经是数十亿令牌进入训练(例如第一个OLMo-2 1B检查站在1000步时已经看到大约3B令牌),因此第4节记录的频率阶段可能会被部分切断.
频率更强的阶段甚至更早。 为了直接检查,我们重新运行OLMo-2 1B阶段1的训练食谱,从随机初始化到1000步.
